A little about us

Made of Moments

We are a small team of photographers and filmmakers who believe the best stories are the ones that feel like you.

From the happy chaos of a birthday to the quiet joy of welcoming a new baby, we capture real people, real connections, and the details you will want to remember. Based in Jaipur, we bring a thoughtful eye, an easygoing approach, and a little cinematic magic to every celebration.

Good to know

Questions & Answers

Have something else in mind? Ask us directly.

How do we book a shoot?+

Send us a message using the contact form with your date, location, and the kind of shoot you have in mind. We will get back to you to talk through the details.

Do you photograph and film events?+

Yes. We offer photography, cinematic video, and combined photo-and-video coverage for weddings, engagements, birthdays, parties, and family milestones.

When will we receive our photos and films?+

Delivery time depends on the event and the collection you choose. We will confirm a clear timeline with you before your booking.

Can we request a custom package?+

Absolutely. Tell us what matters most to you, and we will tailor the coverage, hours, and deliverables to your plans.

Do you travel for shoots?+

We are based in Jaipur and are happy to discuss shoots at other locations. Share your venue or destination when you get in touch.
